description: 48 environmental oxidation literature excerpts (Markdown tables, LaTeX tabulars, and scientific OCR/prose) across 6 micropollutant families (Phenols, Sulfonamides, Beta-blockers, Triazines, Olefins, Amines) with gold canonical RDKit structures, standardized rate constants (M^-1 s^-1), and injected failure modes.
